_process: Golden set for scripts/ask-mmt-eval.js. Every user-reported Ask MMT failure becomes a row here before it is fixed, so the fix is proven against the question that exposed it and cannot regress silently.
Rows carry only what a subscriber typed. Marketing examples (ask.html, the widget, the soft-launch email) are copied verbatim so the questions we advertise are the questions we test.

Fields: id, source (where the question came from), question, history (optional prior turns; an entry may carry answer_from: <row id> to chain the answer produced in the same trial), required (all must appear in the answer, case-insensitive), required_any (at least one must appear), required_cited (must appear in the answer OR a source url/title), forbidden (none may appear), allowed_unavailable (systems that may be not-reached without failing; default sam_opportunities and onc_chpl), max_elapsed_ms (default 45000).
Rows with the same question and history share one run per trial; the result is graded under every id so duplicates cost no extra API calls.

Code graders that apply to every row live in the script, not here: no em dash, no exclamation point, no banned word, no trailing Sources section, every link grounded in the context or sources, no acronym expansion outside the ACRONYM REFERENCE, hasData, FOC never expanded as Field of Competition.
